name: column-header-menu
title: Column header menu
description: A column header with a menu: sort ascending or descending, clear the sort, hide the column, pin it left or right. Each group shows only when you pass its callback.
docs: Use it as the header cell of a column: give it the label, the current sort and the callbacks you support, and the menu shows only those groups. It sets aria-sort on the th itself while the column is sorted, so never add it yourself. Hiding removes the button, so move the focus to the table afterwards. Pinning only reports the edge: the sticky positioning is yours.
